name: ecom Pad-Ex 01 P12 DZ2
summary: The ecom Pad-Ex 01 P12 DZ2 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) 11.6-inch Windows tablet from ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs), certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Windows 11 Pro, version 25H2.
imageAlt: ecom Pad-Ex 01 P12 DZ2, front view

otherSchemes: Japan CML 19 JPN 2478 X, IA/MASC South Africa S/19-6224X, Inmetro TÜV 20.1444 X, China CCC 2020322309003372, KC Korea 24-KA4BO-0914X / 0915X

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc IP64 / II 3D Ex ic op is IIIB T135°C Dc IP64
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 6 (2025-08-05), checked 2026-10-25. ATEX is a voluntary Certificate of Conformity (Bureau Veritas).

iecex.marking: Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc IP64 / Ex ic op is IIIB T135°C Dc IP64

certification.northAmerica: SGS certificate SGSNA/24/SUW/00031X (ecom file CERT-7421A): Class I, Zone 2, AEx ic IIC T4 Gc IP64; Class I, Div 2, Groups A-D T4; Zone 22, AEx ic IIIB T135°C Dc; Class II, Div 2, Class III, Div 1, Groups F, G, T135°C
certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ic) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)

safety.conditions: Battery pack removed, changed or charged only outside hazardous areas; impact test done with reduced height, protect from high-energy impacts, excessive UV and high electrostatic charge; external connections never used in hazardous areas; interface cover closed in hazardous areas; clean only with a damp cloth; use only manufacturer-approved accessories (X-strap, shoulder strap, hand strap, leather case, stylus ST P01 P12).
safety.peripherals: No external connections in the Ex area (Thunderbolt 4, USB-A, micro HDMI, audio, DC-in, dock pogo); interface cover closed.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Certificate allows only: X-strap, shoulder strap, hand strap, leather case (LC P01 A01) and stylus with tether (ST P01 P12). Other accessories on the ecom page (CA P01 A01, HA P01 A01, BP P01 P12 batteries, DC P01 HC dock) are for use outside Ex areas.

os.name: Windows
os.edition: Windows 11 Pro (64-bit); ecom release plan lists Win11 25H2
os.updates: Windows 11: supported while kept on a current version (Microsoft Modern Lifecycle)

specs.outdoor: Maker claims 'Can be used in sunlight' (11.6-inch FHD DynaVue SR display, 1000 nits)
specs.chip: Intel Core i5-1235U (12th gen, vPro); optional Core i7-1255U (DZ2 only)
specs.ports: Thunderbolt 4; USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type A; micro HDMI; audio combo jack; microSD; 35-pin pogo docking connector; DC-in; optional nano-SIM
specs.docking: Dock connector with pass-through (35-pin pogo); DC P01 HC desktop dock (ordinary areas)
specs.keys: On/off, volume up/down, Windows touch button, barcode/camera touch button, programmable touch button
specs.touch: Can be operated while wearing gloves
specs.pen: Passive stylus with tether (ST P01 P12) supplied

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Built in (optional Honeywell N670X 1D/2D scan engine; Ex-certified as part of the unit)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (optional 2 MP front and 11 MP rear cameras; Windows video-call app)

unconfirmed.launchYear: Approximate: the maker doesn't publish a launch date. Based on the certificate date or the maker's announcement.

strengths: ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
Also certified for Class I Division 2 in North America
Camera-free version available for sites that restrict cameras
limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Dust group IIIB: combustible flyings and non-conductive dust only, not conductive dust
